data_quality.finding: 0-bar signals (flipped today) can repaint before the close. On 2026-07-22, CENX and CRWV both showed fresh BUY flips at 10:20am and were back in SELL mode by 2pm.
data_quality.impact: Any 0-bar name in this file is provisional.
data_quality.action: Re-read 0-bar signals after the close before acting.

data_quality.finding: Read on HEIKIN ASHI on the live chart, per Omar's 2026-07-23 standard (reverses the 2026-07-22 candles rule). HA runs are NOT comparable to earlier candle-based runs.

5 of 492 bare tickers resolved to FOREIGN listings, not the US line: BHP -> ASX_DLY:BHP (AUD 60.55), EQR -> ASX_DLY:EQR (EQ Resources Limited, AUD 0.27), COCO -> IDX_DLY:COCO (IDR 141.25), DTE -> XETR_DLY:DTE (Deutsche Telekom, EUR 26.71), SFL -> NSE_DLY:SFL (INR 754.15).
data_quality.impact: All five were re-read as NYSE:/NASDAQ: and the corrected rows replaced the bad ones before gating, so today's numbers are clean. Untouched, EQR and DTE would have been priced as entirely different companies. The sweep's identity guard cannot catch this - the TICKER matches, it is the EXCHANGE that is wrong, so the read looks valid.
data_quality.action: Add BHP, EQR, COCO, DTE and SFL to FORCE_PREFIX in scripts/build_extended_universe.py (it currently only forces FITB and SMCI) so the next run never reads them bare. Rows that were swapped carry a resolution_fixup field in the raw sweep JSON.

data_quality.finding: 2 of 492 names could not be read completely and are NOT in the scanned set: SPCX (Space Exploration Technologies, 28 bars of history) and XMAX (50 bars). Both are too newly listed for the 200-day regime test, which needs 210 bars.
data_quality.impact: Scanned is 490, not 492. Per the fail-closed rule a name that cannot be gate-evaluated is BLOCKED, so neither can appear as a candidate - they are excluded, not silently passed.
data_quality.action: Leave them blocked until they have ~10 months of history. Do not hand-wave the regime gate for recent IPOs.

data_quality.finding: LHX flipped to BUY TODAY (0 bars back) and is one of the four STARTER ONLY names.
data_quality.impact: 0-bar flips repaint. This is the exact failure logged on 2026-07-22 (CENX and CRWV both flipped BUY intraday and were back in SELL by 2pm).
data_quality.action: Re-read LHX after the close before it is treated as a real signal.

data_quality.finding: Alert board refreshed from the live TradingView endpoint: 379 raw alerts -> 287 unique symbols (254 active, 33 auto-deactivated with a fire time). One junk row whose symbol field had stringified to '[object Object]' was dropped. Symbol list and fire timestamps were checksum-verified against the page after writing.
data_quality.impact: The tracked-symbols rule rescued 39 names that no watchlist and no origination tab covers - including ECVT, which is one of today's three full candidates and is exactly the name this rule was built for after it vanished mid-trade on 2026-07-22.

data_quality.finding: stockanalysis.com gainers/losers captured to watchlists/market-movers-2026-07-23.json. The source page shows 20 rows per list, not 25.
data_quality.action: Each still needs the liquidity screen (price >= $5, cap >= $2B, $vol >= $25M) before any protocol run - most of today's movers are sub-$100M microcaps that will screen out.
